charge_port.notes: Estimated: Electrek (2026-04-29) says the 2027 Blazer EV replaces "the CCS connector used on earlier models", so 2024-2026 are CCS1 (J1772 native inlet); no change found between model years. Model year 2024. Canadian car assumed the same (Guide Auto 2024-09-18: Canadian owners need the GM adapter).

supercharger_access.notes: Canadian article (2024-09-18): Canadian Blazer EV, Equinox EV, Silverado EV and LYRIQ owners can buy the GM NACS adapter for Tesla Superchargers. Current state for model year 2024: adapter needed. Markets: CA.
